Quick calc and recommendations:

Inputs taken: 100M tokens/mo baseline, peak 25–30 rps, avg 120 tokens/req.

Indicative hosted pricing plan (ballpark for sales discussion):
- List/standard hosted: $160 / 1M tokens — would put them at $16k/mo (over their top target)
- Volume-discounted hosted (100M+/mo): $100 / 1M tokens — aligns with their target -> $10k/mo
- Committed (reserved) Dedicated capacity: if they need predictable 25–30 rps sustained with low-latency streaming we’d recommend Dedicated pool sized for ~40 rps headroom (1 x medium GPU pool with autoscale to 2 during peaks). Rough commit: $9k–$12k/mo depending on model and SLA. Dedicated gives lower unit cost and predictable latency.

Notes on economics:
- Batching: with our automatic batching, effective per-token cost improves for high-concurrency backfills; however user-facing chat (low-latency) gets less batching benefit. Expect 5–15% savings on token compute with batching for their mix.
- Streaming: negligible per-token surcharge but increases latency sensitivity.
- Recommendation: propose a phased offering — hosted discounted rate at $100 / 1M tokens (pilot 3 months), with an option to move to Dedicated if they need guaranteed latency and steady throughput. Include a clause for true-up if tokens exceed 120M/mo.

I can prep an indicative pricing slide and a sample SOW. Sean — if you can help with contracting timelines and whether $100/1M bucket requires legal/finance approval, that’d be great.

— Dev
